text_blocks.snippet: The incubation period for COVID-19, the time between exposure to the virus and the onset of symptoms, is typically 2-14 days. However, the duration of exposure required to contract COVID-19 can vary depending on factors such as:

list.snippet: Proximity to the infected individual: Closer proximity increases the risk of exposure.
Duration of contact: Longer contact with an infected person increases the risk.
Ventilation: Poorly ventilated areas increase the risk of virus transmission.
Mask usage: Wearing a mask can reduce the risk of exposure.

text_blocks.snippet: In general, prolonged exposure to an infected individual without wearing a mask in a poorly ventilated environment increases the likelihood of contracting COVID-19.
